title: Gentle 8 Ball
subtitle: The SBR pool table, First Court. Reds or yellows, then the black. The committee guards the pockets, but they go easy on a gentle shot. Slam it and they never will.
controls: Drag back from anywhere and let go to shoot. Or Left/Right to aim and hold Space for power. R re-racks.
start: Drag or press Space to break

President: As President, I veto this pocket.
This pocket is reserved for committee business.
I chair this pocket. Point of order.
Co-Vice-President: Co-blocking. It's in the job title.
The other Vice-President has the other pocket.
I'll escalate that shot to the President.
Treasurer: That pot costs GBP1.50. On UPay.
Pocket access is not in the budget.
Have you filled in a reimbursement form?
Sorry, the pocket fund is overdrawn.
Secretary: Please submit pots in writing, 7 days in advance.
That pocket is not on the agenda.
Academic: Pockets are a graduate talk topic. Book one before BA Table.
Has this shot been peer reviewed?
Present this at the Lent research symposium first.
Welfare: Are you okay? You seem very focused on pockets.
Take a break. The pocket will still be here.
This pocket is a safe space. For me.
Environment: This pocket is a protected habitat.
Balls must be cycled, not potted.
Comms: Going live from inside the pocket.

potted: It went in. The committee is reviewing the footage.
A gentle touch. The committee approves.
In! The Treasurer is checking the receipts.
scratch: Scratch. Cue ball back in the D.
The cue ball has left the society. It will be back.
won: Frame won. The committee is calling an emergency general meeting.
You won a frame. Nobody saw it, and the Secretary did not minute it.
lost: Black potted early. Frame lost, rack them up.
Early black. The committee thanks you for your contribution.
rerack: Time's up, next pair on the table.
facts: The SBR room is in the corner of First Court, staircase I2.
The SBR room has a TV with a Wii, board games, a pool table, a piano and a small kitchen.
Your University Card opens the SBR room. Please tidy up after use.
Port & Sherry is served in the SBR before and after BA Table.
BA Table is on Tuesdays and Fridays in term. Port & Sherry after Friday hall is GBP1.50.
The SBR has been the graduate society of St John's since 1960.
Samuel Butler was at St John's from 1854 to 1858. The room is named after him.
There is also a graduate study room at 1 All Saints Passage.
